title: fxv branch new command payload
description: Payload schema for the `fxv branch new` command's JSON output.

branch.description: The branch's displayed form: a bare name for a global branch, '<username>/<name>' for a user branch.

branch_type.description: Whether the branch is owned by a user or lives in the global namespace.

revision.description: The revision spec of the draft revision created for the branch.

source_revision.description: The revision the branch was started from. Absent for a branch created with --from none, which has no parent.

switched.description: Whether the workspace was moved onto the new branch.
